changes_vs_v1_training: dual-elo conditioning: single-scalar rating path in history_context replaced by elo_self + elo_oppo projections (docs/rating-conditioning-finding.md: 0/200 sweep with the scalar)
GAB widened to the paper's 5M configuration: gab_token_projection 16 -> 32 (docs/gab-capacity-finding.md)
objective: legal-only weighted policy cross-entropy (pretrain); stage 2 = same objective on trusted-quality shards (finetune)

throughput round (2026-08-28): micro_batch 128 -> 256 with adaptive accumulation (GLOBAL effective batch stays 4096 at every world size, so the optimizer schedule is unchanged from the single-GPU design); activation_checkpointing off — the 58.5M model at micro 256 uses ~13 GB measured on an A100 (2x the R21 micro-128 6.7 GB), far inside 80 GB; re-enable it if micro_batch_max is raised past 512 or on smaller GPUs

hardware.target: Verda homogeneous NVIDIA GPU node (1-8 GPUs; DDP via torchrun, nccl auto / gloo on CPU)
